root_idea.summary: The evidence preserves a numerical branch centered on one hundred, alongside separate lexical branches for fomenting discord and a cat's mewing.
root_idea.development: The numerical branch includes a transitive use meaning to make a quantity total one hundred and a corresponding intransitive use meaning to become a hundred; the Quranic مِائَة is the numeral itself. The evidence also records مَأَى for a cat's mewing and مَأْي for tale-bearing or causing discord between people.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form مِائَة; the group includes its inflectional variants, including the dual مِائَتَيْنِ.

senses.definition: The number one hundred; a hundred units.
senses.usage_conditions: A cardinal numeral. The supplied Quranic occurrences include the singular مِائَة and the dual مِائَتَيْنِ, meaning one hundred and two hundred respectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a quantity total one hundred; to cause it to become a hundred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence also records the corresponding intransitive result expression, in which the quantity becomes a hundred.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tale-bearing and causing discord between people; to foment mischief between them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related verbal expression مَأَيْتُ بينهم means that one caused discord among them.
A Form I verb describing the cat's cry.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit directly defines مَأَى as a cat's mewing.

cautions: The Quranic form group combines singular and dual inflectional forms; the public headword is the singular citation form مِائَة.
